items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to the issuance of a distinctive license plate for Iraq War and War in Afghanistan veterans
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2139

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in
relation to the issuance of a distinctive license plate for Iraq War
and War in Afghanistan veterans

 PURPOSE :

This bill amends the vehicle and traffic law to add a new section
authorizing the issuance of distinctive license plates bearing the
words "Iraq War Veteran" or "War in Afghanistan Veteran".

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1: Provides that any qualifying Iraq War or War in Afghanistan
veteran or the spouse of any such veteran shall, upon request, be
issued a license plate bearing the words "Iraq War Veteran" or "War in
Afghanistan Veteran". The distinctive plates shall be issued in the
same manner as other member plates upon payment of the regular
registration fee and an additional onetime service charge of ten
dollars for such plate.

Section 2: Provides that that a distinctive plate shall only be
designed, produced, and issued upon the delivery of a surety bond in
the amount of $6000 or at least 200 orders for such distinctive plate
with the additional service charge applicable to each order. All of
the additional service charge will be deposited in the DMV distinctive
place development fund. The language also provides that if after two
years following the date upon which the plate is first made available
for sale 200 or more sets of plates are sold, the bond shall be
discontinued. If fewer than 200 plates are sold within the first 2
years, the DMV shall be entitled to recover against the bond in the
amount proportionate to the short fall.

Section 3: Provides the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Currently, New York State offers distinctive license plates for a
number of veterans who have served our country in the time of various
wars and battles. These plates are available for Korean War Veterans,
Pearl Harbor Survivors, Persian Gulf Veterans, Vietnam Veterans, War
on Terror Veterans and World War II Veterans. This bill would add
those who served in the Iraq War and the War in Afghanistan to the
list of those who would be eligible to receive a distinctive license
plate. We owe a great deal to those who serve our country, who put
their lives on the line to protect and defend our country. Providing
distinctive plates for veterans who have served us in a time of war is
a recognition of their service and sacrifices.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2016: S .6705-A Passed the Senate

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately; provided, however, that
section one of this act shall take effect on the one hundred eightieth
day after it shall have become a law; and provided further, that
effective immediately, the addition, amendment and/or repeal of any
rule or regulation necessary for the implementation of this act on its
effective date are authorized and directed to be made and completed on
or before such effective date.
